newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - Aug 6.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- President Kim Young-sam replaced 11 of 22 cabinet ministers in a reshuffle but retained key ministers including the Prime Minister and Finance-Economy Minister.
- The Korean Air Lines Flight 801 Boeing 747 crashed in Guam on Wednesday.
- Finance and Economy Minister Kang Kyong-shik said the government fully supported Kia Group creditors' decision not to extend rescue loans before Kia pledges in writing to give up managment rights.
- North Korea said Tuesday it was ready to abide by the 1953 armistice agreement that ended in Korean War unitl a new peace mechanism came into effect.
